## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] EMA lists EMA/CHMP/330418/2012 rev. 2 as the current effective Parkinson’s guideline; its later concept paper proposes replacing that guideline, rather than constituting an adopted replacement. ## Research summary — Regulatory pathways (FDA, EMA) for PD therapies

Regulatory evidence for Parkinson’s therapies spans medicinal-product guidance, biomarker support and qualification, drug applications and approvals, and device supplements. EMA distinguishes its effective guideline from a concept paper proposing revision. Biomarker support letters have a narrower meaning than qualification. Concrete examples illustrate FDA drug applications, a device supplement, and distinct European authorisation routes. Sponsor announcements are attributed separately from regulator records. FDA’s discussion of real-world evidence also documents limits on its use in labeling.
